title: Plan month note shows the previous budget's note after switching budgets
notes:
Pre-existing (identical code in syscd). PlanScreen MonthSummary: useState(budget.monthNotes?.[month]) never resyncs when the budget (or loaded notes) change; reload shows the right note. Repro: open Trabalho plan, switch to Casa via Open Budget: Nov note empty until reload.
Fixed: month note follows the active budget (domain/noteDraft, MonthSummary keyed by budget), commit c7b0ffb, merged to main at 4c3532b; regression pass docs/decisions.md 'Phase 5a/5e'.
